name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Rest hands lightly beside the head or across the chest.
Curl the ribs toward the pelvis until the shoulder blades lift.
Lower slowly without pulling on the neck.
cues: Keep a small space between chin and chest.
mistakes: Pulling the head forward with the hands.
Using momentum to sit all the way up.
breathing: Exhale while curling up; inhale while lowering.
